question: Which Indian city is the host of the International Kite Festival 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is 'Ahmedabad'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The International Kite Festival 2023 began in Ahmedabad, Gujarat on January 08.
 
• The festival is being organized by Gujarat Tourism on the **G20 theme of 'One Earth, One Family, One Future', **and will be held from January 8 to 14.
 
• Apart from Ahmedabad, the **International Kite Festival **will also be organized in **Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot, Dwarka, Somnath, Dhordo, and Kevadia.**
 
• More than** 800 kite flyers** from across India and the world(65 countries) will participate and display their unique creations in this Festival.
 
• This year, kite enthusiasts from different countries will fly Kites at the same time attempting to create a Guinness World Record for the maximum number of kite flyers.
 
• A special Parade by international and national kite flyers, a theme pavilion displaying the history of kites, and workshops on making and flying kites are among the major attractions of the festival this year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• Ahmedabad is the most populous city in the Indian state of Gujarat. It is the administrative headquarters of the Ahmedabad district and the seat of the Gujarat High Court. 
 
• It is the second-largest producer of cotton in India, due to which it was known as the 'Manchester of India' along with Kanpur.
 
• In July 2017, the Historic City **of Ahmedabad, or Old Ahmedabad, was declared a UNESCO World Heritage City.**
